title: F8 is an in game snipping tool: it freezes the game, you drag a box, then copy it or save it
why: His order (2026-10-18): "add one that is an in game snipping tool so it pauses the game and i can snip whatever portion of the page that i like to send it to you", then "i want option to copy to clipboard so i can easily send it wherever I want". F8 (this machine only, like the Edit the words key) freezes the game through the same one freeze the F2 key built (devFreeze), dims the screen a little and makes the cursor a cross. He drags a box (outline and size in px); on release the box is cut out, the game stays frozen, and a small panel beside it has two buttons, copy (the picture goes to the clipboard as one image/png item, written inside the click) and save (the Feedback windows own route: a post to the collector that writes exports/feedback-STAMP.txt and .png, with a note that names the build, the screen or raid, the map and the box). Either, then the other, as often as he likes. ESC, F8 or a click outside the panel ends it; only then the game carries on, the click that ended it fires no shot and no key or button is left held. The picture is the screen at the moment of the key: the two canvases (as the Feedback shot) plus the page elements (menus, windows, the upper right block, toasts) laid over them from a copy of the page rendered as a picture; if that layer fails the snip is the canvases alone and the note says so. Mouse and keyboard only: the pad is not read while a snip is up. F8 cannot be bound to an action.
now: F8 freezes the game so you can drag a box around any part of the screen. Press copy to put it on your clipboard, or save to write it to the exports folder. ESC or F8 carries on.
